newsitem.title: USA: Clinton "extremely interested" in British vote. [CORRECTED 03:01 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Clinton "extremely interested" in British vote. [CORRECTED 03:01 GMT]

text.p: President Bill Clinton was "extremely interested" in the British election and confident there will be continuity in the close relations between the two nations, his chief spokesman said on Thursday night. (Corrects day from Wednesday to Thursday)

"We're well aware of the projected returns" that show a landslide win for Tony Blair's Labour party, White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said. He declined to give an official reaction to the end of 18 years of Conservative rule.
"The president has been getting reports" on the election, McCurry said, noting that "he's extremely interested."
"He's also confident there will be continuity between U.S. and United Kingdom relations," McCurry said.
